    assert limiter2.hit('key2', 0) == True
    assert limiter2.hit('key2', 1) == True

    assert limiter2.count('key2', 3) == 2
    
    # 测试窗口边界

    assert limiter3.hit('key3', 0) == True
    assert limiter3.hit('key3', 4) == True
